purpose: A false positive: the PR description and code already agree, so the right outcome is a decline with no code change.

pull_request.title: fix(github): retry transient gh reads and coordinate gh calls across sessions
pull_request.body:
## Summary

- Bound the `gh auth status` preflight with a 30s timeout and one jittered retry on transient failures.
- GitHubClient calls keep their existing 60s timeout (`GH_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`).

## Validation

- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`

commits.message: fix(github): bound the gh auth preflight and retry transient failures

items.why: The 30s preflight timeout is intentional and the PR description states it; 60s is the GitHubClient call timeout.
